attchmntText: Page Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on Media Reports regarding FEMA Non-Compliance in Q2-FY27 Results
voiceSummary: Page Industries Limited submitted a clarification to BSE and NSE on 13 November 2026 regarding media reports on FEMA non-compliance in its Q2-FY27 results. The company states that the non-compliance under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999, related to retail trading of Jockey and Speedo branded products, was already disclosed in Note No. 40 of the audited financial statements for FY 2025-26. This prior disclosure was filed with stock exchanges on 16 July 2026. The clarification references the submission of the Statement of Unaudited Ind AS Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026, which was intimated on 12 November 2026. The company requests the exchanges to take this information on record. Arjun Sunil Makhecha, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter.

attchmntText: Please note that the Company executives will be participating in the Institutional Investors' Meeting - Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia-Pacific Summit, scheduled to be held on November 18 & 19, 2026 at Singapore. It is expected that the meeting with the investors will be on one-on-one basis.
voiceSummary: Reliance Industries Limited disclosed that its executives will participate in the Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia-Pacific Summit in Singapore on November 18 and 19, 2026. The meetings with investors are expected to be on a one-on-one basis. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared or discussed during these meetings. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of one year effective from November 23, 2026. This approval follows recommendations from the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and consent from the Reserve Bank of India. The re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Rangan will continue at extant remuneration. He is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank and is not debarred from holding office. The bank will seek shareholder approval for this re-appointment.

attchmntText: ITC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 785300  Shares.
voiceSummary: ITC Limited allotted 7,85,300 ordinary shares of one rupee each on 13th November 2026. This allotment resulted from the exercise of 78,530 options by optionees under the company's Employee Stock Option Schemes. The committee meeting for the allotment concluded at 3:10 p.m. Consequently, the issued and subscribed share capital of ITC Limited increased to 1253,26,97,881 rupees. This capital is divided into 1253,26,97,881 ordinary shares of one rupee each. The change is effective from 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Trent Limited has informed the Exchange about Reminder letter to  shareholders to Dematerialise the Shares
voiceSummary: Trent Limited issued a reminder on 13th November 2026 to shareholders holding physical shares to dematerialize them. The company cites SEBI regulations prohibiting the transfer of physical shares since April 1, 2021, and the issuance of new physical certificates since January 2022. Shareholders are urged to contact their Depository Participant to convert physical holdings into demat form. The letter outlines benefits including convenient holding, immediate transfer, reduced paperwork, and direct credit for corporate actions. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent is MUFG Intime India Private Limited. Queries can be directed to them at Mumbai. The intimation is also placed on the company website.

attchmntText: KDDL Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: KDDL Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027 with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on 13th November 2026. The standalone total income for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 174.7 crore, representing a 37.7% year-over-year increase. Standalone EBITDA stood at Rs. 39.4 crore, up 36.3%, while profit after tax reached Rs. 21.8 crore, a 50.6% rise. Consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 698.7 crore, up 31.6%. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 112.1 crore, up 29.8%, and consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 48.2 crore, up 47.5%. The presentation includes forward-looking statements and safe harbor provisions.

attchmntText: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has submitted the Exchange the Voting Results and the Scrutinizer's Report of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT") Convened Meeting of the Unsecured Creditors of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited has submitted the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with Kothari Petrochemicals Limited to the National Stock Exchange. The meeting of Unsecured Creditors was held on November 13, 2026. Dr. Biswarup Acharya served as the Scrutinizer appointed by the National Company Law Tribunal. The resolution for the scheme was approved by the requisite majority of Unsecured Creditors. The resolution is deemed passed as on November 13, 2026, under section 230(6) of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme remains subject to the final approval of the National Company Law Tribunal.

attchmntText: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has submitted the Exchange the Voting Results and the Scrutinizer's Report of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT") Convened Meeting of the Equity Shareholders of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited held on November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited has submitted the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with Kothari Petrochemicals Limited. The Equity Shareholders Meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Dr. Biswarup Acharya served as the Scrutinizer. The resolution for the scheme was approved by the requisite majority of equity shareholders. The resolution is deemed passed as on November 13, 2026, under Section 230(6) of the Companies Act, 2013. The company filed this information with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited in compliance with Regulation 44 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The scheme remains subject to the approval of the National Company Law Tribunal.

attchmntText: Vertoz Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vertoz Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 5,446.38 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 498.33 lakhs. Profit for the period was 369.80 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.43. Total assets were 14,875.50 lakhs. The auditor issued a clean review report. Consolidated results include subsidiaries such as Adzurite Solutions, Own Web Solutions, and Vertoz Inc.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands.
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands. The Board of Directors made this decision during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. Sarveshwar Foods Limited will hold 100% of the shareholding in the new entity. The subscription to the share capital will be made in cash. The name of the proposed entity is yet to be approved by the relevant authorities. The date of incorporation is not yet determined. The entity is currently not incorporated. The industry and business background are yet to be ascertained. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Thirumalai Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: Thirumalai Chemicals Limited received a show cause notice from the Deputy Commissioner, Commercial Tax Department, Ranipet, Tamil Nadu, under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017. The notice relates to an alleged claim of ineligible Input Tax Credit under section 17(5) of the GST Act, 2017, for the financial year 2023-24. The company will submit its response within prescribed timelines. The expected financial implications include a tax demand of Rs. 6.80 lakhs, interest of Rs. 3.14 lakhs, and a penalty of Rs. 0.68 lakhs, totaling Rs. 10.62 lakhs. The company believes these demands are erroneous and not sustainable. It states that any financial impact is likely to be insignificant and will not materially affect its financial position.

attchmntText: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'ALM Reporting - Debt listed on BSE'.
voiceSummary: Capri Global Capital Limited filed its Asset Liability Management statement for the month ending October 31, 2026, with the Reserve Bank of India. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited, National Stock Exchange of India Limited, and India International Exchange on November 13, 2026. The report covers the period from October 1, 2026, to October 31, 2026. The document includes the Statement of Structural Liquidity and the Statement of Interest Rate Sensitivity. The filing is marked as Un-Audited. The company is classified as a Non-Deposit taking Systemically Important NBFC. The reporting currency is INR and the scale is in Lakhs. The return code is R228. The bank or FI code is MUM08037.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about unsecured Loan Agreement entered between Sarveshwar Foods Limited and Sarveshwar Overseas Limited
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited entered into an unsecured loan agreement with its subsidiary, Sarveshwar Overseas Limited, on 13 November 2026. The agreement allows the parent company to lend an aggregate amount not exceeding INR 25 Crores in one or more tranches. The subsidiary will utilize the funds for general corporate purposes. Sarveshwar Foods Limited holds 99% shares in the borrower. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction conducted at arm's length. No security is provided for the loan. The current outstanding loan amount is INR 12.99 crores. The agreement does not include special rights regarding director appointments or share subscriptions.

attchmntText: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Sarveshwar Foods Limited Explores Strategic Opportunities to Strengthen Logistics and Warehousing Infrastructure".
voiceSummary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited submitted a press release on November 13, 2026, stating it is exploring strategic opportunities to strengthen logistics and warehousing infrastructure. The company is evaluating alternatives, including establishing a dedicated logistics business, to support export, organic, and B2B distribution operations. A dedicated committee may be constituted to assess commercial viability. The initiative is at a preliminary exploratory stage. No final decision has been taken. Any material developments will be disclosed to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: RITES Limited has informed the Exchange about change in senior management of the Company.
voiceSummary: RITES Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited about a change in its senior management. Shri Rajen Singha has been included in the Senior Management of the Company with effect from 13.11.2026. He has taken over the charge as Additional Regional Head (NERPO) in addition to his existing responsibility of PU Head (Guwahati). Shri Rajen Singha holds a Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering from JRN Rajasthan Vidyapeeth University, Udaipur. He is a senior Civil Engineering professional with more than three decades of experience with RITES Limited.

attchmntText: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings under SEBI Listing Regulations. Institutional investors will interact with company officials via in-person multiple one-on-one or group meetings on November 18, 2026. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Discussions will reference the investor presentation uploaded on the company website on October 29, 2026. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings. The information is available on www.kissht.com.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report in respect of Rights Issue (2026) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue undertaken in 2026. The report was issued by Acuité Ratings and Research Limited. The total issue size was INR 154.29 crore. The monitoring agency observed no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. No material deviations in expenditure were noted. There was no change in the means of finance. No major deviations were observed compared to earlier reports, as this is the first such report. All necessary government and statutory approvals were obtained. No arrangements for technical assistance were required. No favorable or unfavorable events affecting the viability of the objects were observed. No other material information affecting investor decision-making was evident. The issuer has not utilized any funds towards the objects during the reporting period. Unutilized proceeds were maintained in escrow and current accounts.

attchmntText: Integrated Filing (Financial) for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Ritco Logistics Limited filed its integrated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 43,905.91 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was 561.65 lakh rupees. Net profit attributable to the owner of the company was 404.84 lakh rupees. Earnings per equity share was 1.41 rupees. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 80,417.63 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was 1,253.44 lakh rupees. Net profit attributable to the owner of the company was 955.10 lakh rupees. Earnings per equity share was 3.34 rupees. Subsidiary Trucksup Solutions Private Limited issued 15,65,200 Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares aggregating to 78,26,00,000 rupees. The statutory auditors, Mittal and Associates, reviewed the results and reported no material misstatements.

attchmntText: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Dharak Mehta as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: BLS International Services Limited has intimated the resignation of Mr. Dharak Mehta from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective from the close of business hours on November 13, 2026. The resignation was tendered on account of personal reasons. Mr. Mehta holds ICSI Membership Number FCS12878. The company expressed appreciation for his contributions to corporate governance and compliance functions during his tenure. The Board wished him success in future professional endeavors. This information is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The resignation letter and details are enclosed as Annexure A. The announcement was signed by Amit Sudhakar, Chief Financial Officer.

attchmntText: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication on the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 12th November 2026. Total income from operations was Rs. 106.59 crores for the quarter and Rs. 188.33 crores for the half year. Net profit after tax was Rs. 5.09 crores for the quarter and Rs. 4.26 crores for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs. 1 for the quarter and Rs. 0.84 for the half year. The company provided Rs. 1.66 crores as interest on delayed payments to MSME suppliers. Newspaper advertisements were published on 13th November 2026. Shiva Texyarn Limited also reported results for the same period. Total income was Rs. 8,789.68 lakhs for the quarter. Net profit after tax was Rs. 311.78 lakhs. Tierra Agrotech Limited reported consolidated losses. Profit after tax was negative Rs. 1,098.02 lakhs for the quarter.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about the Proposal to make investment in Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited to acquire 6.5% equity stake under group captive scheme.
voiceSummary: INDO-MIM Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved an investment proposal to subscribe to equity shares of M/s. Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited. The investment amount will not exceed Rs. 97,500, representing 6.5% of the Target Company's share capital. The Company will enter into a Power Purchase Agreement and a Share Purchase Agreement to purchase electricity under the Group Captive Scheme. The Company will update the Stock Exchange upon execution of these agreements. The Board meeting commenced at 07:00 P.M. and concluded at 08:00 P.M. on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Sai Life Sciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Revision
voiceSummary: Sai Life Sciences Limited announced that India Ratings upgraded its long-term bank loan rating to IND AA from IND AA- with a Stable Outlook on 13th November 2026. The short-term rating was affirmed at IND A1+. The upgrade reflects sustained improvement in business and financial profile, supported by growth in contract research and manufacturing businesses, stronger operating profitability, and comfortable credit metrics. Consolidated revenue increased to INR21,925 million in FY26. The company plans a capital expenditure of INR11 billion to INR13 billion in FY27, which may keep net leverage elevated relative to current levels. The Stable Outlook indicates expectations that the company will sustain its strengthened business profile while managing higher capital expenditure without significant deterioration in leverage.

attchmntText: Approval of SWELECT ESOP Scheme 2026
voiceSummary: SWELECT Energy Systems Limited approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter was Rs. 1,460.13 lakhs with basic EPS of Rs. 5.62. For the six months, standalone net profit was Rs. 2,225.52 lakhs with basic EPS of Rs. 12.32. The Board also approved the SWELECT ESOP Scheme 2026 for the grant of 75,794 options to eligible employees. This scheme is subject to shareholder approval. A Postal Ballot Notice will be issued to shareholders for approval of the ESOP Scheme and related party transactions with subsidiary companies for solar power projects. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms.

Mr. Rajesh Valiya Naduvath retired from the company on the same date. The Board approved shifting the corporate office to Ahmedabad effective December 3, 2026. The company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of IPO proceeds.

attchmntText: Tvs Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited approved the appointment of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP as Internal Auditor for FY 2026-27 on November 13, 2026. The Board also approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory Auditor S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP issued Limited Review Reports on these results. Revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 3,687.15 crores, compared to Rs. 3,335.22 crores in the same period last year. attchmntText: Reply/Clarification to notice regarding non-compliance/delayed compliance with regulation 33 of SEBI regulation, 2015 and non-submission of reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report in the matter of Astron Paper and Board Mill Limited Under CIRP
voiceSummary: Astron Paper & Board Mill Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, submitted a clarification to the National Stock Exchange regarding deficiencies in financial reporting and regulatory compliance. Resolution Professional Atul J Sheth stated that the CIRP commenced on May 11, 2026, and the RP assumed responsibility only from that date. The company cited non-availability of financial records, non-cooperation from suspended management, and technical issues with the MCA portal as reasons for delays. Specific pending items include standalone and consolidated limited review reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and the annual report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The RP requested reasonable time to complete requisite filings and verify historical information. The submission was made without prejudice to the rights of stakeholders and does not admit personal liability for historical non-compliances.

attchmntText: Arshiya Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial  for quarter and half year ended on September 2026.
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Arshiya Limited disclosed reasons for delaying the submission of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since April 23, 2024, with Resolution Professional Pankaj Mahajan exercising powers. Delays stem from logistical challenges following the registered office relocation effective April 29, 2024, and significant staff attrition where 50 out of 71 employees resigned between July 30 and August 2, 2024. The Resolution Professional is currently collecting financial data, a process hindered by the non-receipt of financials from multiple subsidiaries. The company aims to submit the results at the earliest.

attchmntText: Juniper Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Others
voiceSummary: Juniper Green Energy Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited that India Ratings and Research has withdrawn the credit rating for its term loan facility from Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited. The withdrawal follows the full repayment of the loan amounting to 83.24 Crores and the receipt of a no-dues certificate from the lender. The instrument size was 832.40 million rupees. The rating action is effective as of November 12, 2026. India Ratings confirmed that the rating is no longer required to be maintained because the instrument has been paid in full. The company requested the withdrawal of the rating. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Harrisons  Malayalam Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Harrisons Malayalam Limited appointed Mr. Gopal Rathi, DIN 00553066, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The Board approved this appointment on November 13, 2026, following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Mr. Rathi is liable to retire by rotation. His appointment as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director is subject to shareholder approval within three months. The company confirmed that Mr. Rathi is not debarred from holding the office of director by SEBI or any other authority. He is also not disqualified under Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013. Mr. Rathi has 25 years of experience in finance, business strategy, and mergers and acquisitions. He holds a bachelor’s degree in commerce from the University of Calcutta and is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He is not related to any existing director of the company.

attchmntText: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations andDisclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015: Transfer of equity shares held by Insolation Green Energy Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Insolation Energy Limited, in its Wholly Owned Subsidiary Companies

attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited announced changes to its Key Managerial Personnel following a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Mr. Ashok Kumar Gurnani, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, will retire from service effective November 30, 2026, upon completion of his extended employment period. The Board approved the appointment of Ms. Shubha Singh as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective December 1, 2026. Ms. Singh is a qualified Company Secretary with ICSI membership number A16735. She holds an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad, an LL.B., and a B.Com. from Delhi University. She also has a CFA and PGDFA from ICFAI and completed an Executive CEO Program at IIM Lucknow. Prior to this role, she served as Company Secretary and Legal Head at JBM Group since June 2024. She is not related to any Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Company.

attchmntText: Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement between H-One India Private Limited and Belrise Industries Limited
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved a scheme of amalgamation with its wholly owned subsidiary, H-One India Private Limited, on November 13, 2026. The transferor company will merge into the transferee company under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The board also resolved to cancel a previous amalgamation scheme approved on November 11, 2025, withdrawing the earlier intimation. The merger aims to create synergies, streamline operations, and simplify the corporate structure. There is no cash or share consideration involved. As the transferor is a wholly owned subsidiary, the transferee's shares in the subsidiary will be cancelled upon the scheme's effectiveness. There will be no change in the shareholding pattern of Belrise Industries Limited. The scheme is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.

attchmntText: Polyplex Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Polyplex Corporation Limited declared an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27 at Rs. 12 per share with a face value of Rs. 10. The record date for this dividend is November 20, 2026. Payment will be made within the time prescribed under law, subject to TDS or withholding tax. The board meeting took place on November 13, 2026, starting at 1510 hours IST and concluding at 1636 hours IST.

attchmntText: Shalimar Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Shalimar Paints Limited has closed its trading window for designated persons and their immediate relatives effective November 13, 2026. The closure remains in place until 48 hours after the determination of the issue price for the Qualified Institutions Placement. The QIP Committee of the Board of Directors designated November 13, 2026, as the relevant date for the Qualified Institutions Placement. The committee also approved the opening of the issue of equity shares with a face value of ₹ 2/- each by way of the Qualified Institutions Placement on November 13, 2026. This intimation is available on the company website at www.shalimarpaints.com.

attchmntText: Powerica Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Income Tax Order regarding Income Tax refund payable to the Company.
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Powerica Limited disclosed that it received an income tax rectification order dated July 02, 2026, on November 02, 2026. The order was passed under Section 154 of the Income-tax Act, 1961. The Income Tax Department found the company's contentions correct regarding Assessment Year 2025-26. Consequently, a total income tax refund of Rs. 15,98,56,158 has been determined payable to the company. The company stated there is no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities during the current financial year. No penalties or restrictions were imposed. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company apologized for the delay in reporting, citing workload related to finalizing financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Significant movement in price has been observed in Flexituff Ventures International Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, has written to the company. The response from the company is awaited.

Shiv Aum Steels Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 68002000 equity shares of Rs. 2 each.
voiceSummary: Shiv Aum Steels Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board proposed subdividing existing equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 into five shares each with a face value of Rs. 2, subject to member approval. This split will alter the Memorandum of Association to reflect a total share capital of Rs. 15,00,00,000 divided into 7,50,00,000 equity shares. M Rupareliya & Associates was appointed as the scrutinizer for the voting process. The trading window for designated persons remains closed for 48 hours after the announcement. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 344.08 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Barak Valley Cements Limited has informed regarding submission of revised results
voiceSummary: Barak Valley Cements Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Standalone and Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results for the Second quarter and year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditor issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified opinion. The company also approved Related Party Transactions for the period. Standalone Total Assets stood at 21,079.20 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026, compared to 19,615.45 Lakhs at 31st March 2026. Standalone Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities was 127.10 Lakhs for the half year ended 30th September 2026, compared to 276.77 Lakhs in the previous year. The meeting commenced at 03:00 P.M. and concluded at 4:15 P.M.

attchmntText: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Vishal Nirmiti Limited has intimated credit ratings for its bank facilities. Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited assigned a Long Term Rating of IVR BBB plus Stable and a Short Term Rating of IVR A2. Both ratings were upgraded. The total bank loan facilities amount to Rs. 115.00 Crore. This figure is reduced from Rs. 120.80 crore. The ratings are regulated by the RBI. The company secretary is Suhas Ganpat Naik. The intimation was filed on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Bharat Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Bharat Electronics Limited has received orders worth Rs. 619 Crore since the last disclosure on 6th November 2026. The company is a Navratna Defence Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence. Major orders include communication equipment, drones, electro optics, laser range finder, components, upgrades, spares, and services. This information is disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The press release was issued on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: Steelcast Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November, 2026. The Board approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared a Second Interim Dividend for FY 2026-27 at Rs. 0.45 per equity share, payable on or before 13th December, 2026. The Record Date is fixed as 20.11.2026. The Board also approved an additional investment of Rs. 31 Crores in Greenfield Foundry for capacity addition of 3250 Tons. This brings the total approved capacity addition to 11750 Tons and total investment to Rs. 151 Crores. The new capacity is to be added by 31/03/2028. Net profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 4,741.17 Lakhs.

attchmntText: Akg Exim Limited has informed the Exchange about related Party Transactions
voiceSummary: AKG Exim Limited submitted a disclosure on Related Party Transactions for the half year ended September 30, 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Regulations. The disclosure covers related party transactions on a consolidated basis in accordance with applicable accounting standards. The information is available on the company website at www.akg-global.com and the National Stock Exchange website at www.nseindia.com. The submission was made by Reeta, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The date of the letter is November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Mufin Green Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of Authorised Dealer Category II License by Reserve Bank of India, Foreign Exchange Department
voiceSummary: Mufin Green Finance Limited has received an Authorised Dealer Category-II Licence from the Reserve Bank of India Foreign Exchange Department. This approval permits the company to undertake permissible foreign exchange activities. The licence remains valid until revoked or surrendered. The company states that this authorization enables it to conduct foreign exchange transactions and offer related services. The disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. No withdrawal, cancellation, or suspension of the licence has occurred. The announcement was issued by Company Secretary Mayank Pratap Singh on 13-11-2026 from Delhi.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue of Convertible Warrants
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 3,910.16 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a profit after tax of 1,400.38 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved a preferential issue of up to 22,10,885 convertible warrants to non-promoters at Rs. 73.50 each, raising up to Rs. 16,25,00,047.50. This issue is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval. An Extraordinary General Meeting will be held on December 11, 2026, via video conferencing to seek shareholder approval for the preferential issue.

attchmntText: Asian Hotels (East) Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- New
voiceSummary: Asian Hotels East Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board noted a limited review report from M/s Singhi & Co. The auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to non-recognition of impairment provisions for investments in subsidiary GJS Hotels Limited, citing a Government of Odisha order directing vacation of property and invocation of a Rs. 350 lakhs bank guarantee. The auditor stated that recognizing impairment would increase expenses by Rs. 1,344.50 lakhs, reducing net profit to Rs. 828.30 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 298.32 lakhs for the half year. The company reported a net profit of Rs. 516.20 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 1,046.18 lakhs for the half year. India Ratings and Research assigned an IND BBB+/Stable rating to Rs. 165 crores in bank loan facilities. The Board also noted an emphasis of matter regarding recoverability of Rs. 25,713.83 lakhs invested in subsidiary Novak Hotels Private Limited, dependent on the acquisition of Hyatt Regency Mumbai.

attchmntText: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Redemption of Debentures.
sm_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
voiceSummary: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited redeemed 1,500 unsecured, subordinated, listed, rated, redeemable, non-convertible debentures aggregating Rs. 150,00,00,000/- pursuant to the exercise of a call option. The redemption was executed at par on November 13, 2026, under ISIN INE995S08010. The original redemption date was November 15, 2026, but payment was advanced to November 13, 2026, as the original date was not a business day. The company repaid the principal amount in full along with accrued interest. The interest payment of Rs. 14,44,50,000/- was also made on November 13, 2026, net of TDS. This action complies with SEBI Listing Regulations and the SEBI Master Circular for Issue and Listing of Non-convertible Securities.

attchmntText: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Grant of 116050 Options to eligible employees of the Company.
voiceSummary: IZMO Limited granted 1,16,050 stock options to eligible employees under the ESOP 2013 scheme. The exercise price is Rs. 10 per option. Each option converts into one equity share of Rs. 10. The grant follows the Nomination Remuneration Committee recommendation. The exercise period starts from the vesting date. It expires within sixty months or five years from vesting. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits Regulations 2021. Shares arising from exercise rank pari passu with existing equity shares. No options have vested, been exercised, lapsed, or varied. The company filed this disclosure with BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 1,531.70 million for the quarter and 9,045.00 million for the six-month period. The Board appointed Mr. Dhanraj Dagar as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 14, 2026, replacing Ms. Mania Sarkar. The Board also proposed an alteration to the Articles of Association by inserting new Article 127A, subject to member approval. Statutory auditors S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP issued a review report noting an emphasis of matter regarding ongoing litigation and uncertainty over receivables of 886.06 million from a customer as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: DEE Development Engineers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Monthly Business Updates for the month of October 2026
voiceSummary: DEE Development Engineers Limited filed an intimation regarding updates on its monthly execution and order position for the period from 1st October 2026 to 31st October 2026. The total order inflow during October 2026, including amendments and currency fluctuations, was 148.41. The total executed value during the same period was 93.02. The closing order book as of 31st October 2026 stood at 2,586.43. The cumulative order inflow for the financial year 2026-27 as of 31st October 2026 was 1,327.06. The cumulative order executed for the financial year 2026-27 as of 31st October 2026 was 684.54. This information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities
voiceSummary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has approved the issuance of zero coupon, secured, redeemable, rated, listed, non-convertible debentures through private placement. The total issue size aggregates up to Rs. 800,00,00,000. This comprises a base issue of Rs. 600,00,00,000 and a green shoe option to retain oversubscription up to Rs. 200,00,00,000. The debentures have a face value of Rs. 1,00,000 each. The company proposes to list these securities on BSE Limited. The obligations are secured by a first ranking pari passu charge on hypothecated properties. A penalty coupon of 2% applies for delayed payments. Specific terms regarding tenor, coupon rates, and redemption schedules are detailed in the key information document. The Finance Committee authorized this issuance on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Vardhman Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Amendment(s).
voiceSummary: Vardhman Textiles Limited has executed an Amended Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement with ASG Holdco Beta Pte. Ltd., Mr. Nikesh Sinha, and Sone Solar Energy One Private Limited on 13th November 2026. This action follows the approval of the Committee of Directors for Renewable Energy. The amendment inducts Mr. Nikesh Sinha as a Co-Developer Shareholder alongside ASG Holdco Beta Pte. Ltd. The original agreement, dated 25th November 2025, pertains to setting up a ground mounted solar power generation facility in Punjab with a capacity of 30 MWac or 42 MWp on a group captive basis. The directors meeting commenced at 1:30 p.m. and concluded at 2:00 p.m. The company has intimated this update to the BSE and NSE pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Precot Limited has informed the Exchange about Demerger
voiceSummary: Precot Limited announced on 13th November 2026 that its Board of Directors granted in-principle approval for the proposed demerger of identified non-core assets. The plan involves transferring these assets, including an investment in Suprem Associates, into a separate resulting company via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The demerged division had a turnover of NIL in the preceding financial year. The rationale includes separating non-core assets to allow management to focus on growth and improving transparency. Existing non-promoter shareholders will receive compensation for shares in the resulting entity, with value determined by an independent valuer. Listing is not sought for the resulting company. The proposal is subject to approvals from the Board, shareholders, creditors, the National Company Law Tribunal, the Stock Exchange, and other regulatory authorities.

attchmntText: COSMO FIRST LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Demise of  Mr. Hoshang Noshirwan Sinor , Non- Executive Director of the company on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cosmo First Limited intimates the cessation of directorship of Mr. Hoshang Noshirwan Sinor, DIN 00074905, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, consequent to his demise on November 12, 2026. The company filed this notice under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The Board conveyed condolences to the bereaved family. The disclosure was submitted to BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Kopran Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Kopran Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: Kopran Limited responded to a surveillance query from the National Stock Exchange of India regarding a significant increase in trading volume. The company stated that it has made all required disclosures under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. Kopran confirmed that no material information was withheld that could impact the price or volume of its scrip. The company attributed the volume increase to market forces. The clarification was issued by Company Secretary Sunil Sodhani in response to an email from the NSE Surveillance Department dated November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Nomination and Remuneration Committee / Compensation Committee Meeting held on November 13, 2026 regarding Grant of Options under Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022
voiceSummary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited granted 77,071 stock options to eligible employees under the Zaggle Employee Stock Option Scheme 2022. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved this grant on November 13, 2026. Each option is convertible into one equity share with a face value of ₹ 1. The exercise price is set at ₹ 130 per stock option. This price reflects a 25% discount to the closing market price on November 12, 2026. Options are exercisable from the vesting date until ten years after the final tranche vests. The allotted shares are not subject to any lock-in period. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations, 2021.

attchmntText: Rochana Tarang Jain has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 10 (5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
voiceSummary: Varroc Engineering Limited received an intimation from Rochana Tarang Jain regarding the proposed acquisition of 5,000 equity shares from Mr. Tarang Jain, the Promoter and Chairman and Managing Director. The transfer is by way of gift between the promoter and his immediate relative, the spouse. The acquisition is valued at NIL. The transaction represents 0.00% of the total paid-up equity share capital. The proposed date of acquisition is on or after June 29, 2026. This inter-se transfer is exempt from making an open offer under Regulation 10(1)(a)(i) of SEBI SAST Regulations. The transfer is for private family arrangement. Mr. Tarang Jain’s shareholding will decrease from 6,07,29,800 shares to 6,07,24,800 shares. Mrs. Rochana Tarang Jain’s shareholding will increase from 0 to 5,000 shares.

attchmntText: Shankara Building Products Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Recommendations on the Open Offer to the shareholders of Shankara Building Products Limited (SBPL or TC or Target Company) by Committee of Independent Directors in terms of Regulation 26(7) of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 (SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011).
